rules.notes: AUTOMATED TOOLS EXPLICITLY PROHIBITED: Policy states 'Please do not use automatic scanners — be creative and do it yourself! We cannot accept any submissions found by using automatic scanners.' Rate limit cap is max 5 requests/sec even for manual testing. CONTACT FORMS: 'Please DO NOT use any scanner or tool on contact forms.' SAFE HARBOR: Policy states 'We respect the safe harbour clause' — set safe_harbor=true (read from policy, not dump). CVE AGE: Program explicitly states zero-days within 14 days post-patch are out of scope, which implies a 14-day minimum CVE age rather than the default 30; set cve_age_min_days=14. HEALTHCARE/GDPR: Program explicitly lists 'leaking of personal and medical data' as a priority finding type — GDPR Article 9 (special category health data) applies to all assets. No production clinical system testing guidance given explicitly; no sandbox credentials provided. Researchers test against production. Treat any clinical-facing asset (ecrf, pcrstudioruzb, mir*, mirc, contactallerg*) with extreme caution — patient safety risk. HEALTHCARE-SPECIFIC NOTE: ecrf.uzleuven.be is an eCRF (Electronic Case Report Form) system for clinical trials; pcrstudioruzb.uzleuven.be is a PCR/lab system; *.mir.uzleuven.be and mirc.uzleuven.be are medical imaging/radiology assets — all contain GDPR Article 9 special category data. INFRASTRUCTURE PROFILE: Heavy on-prem naming conventions: prddsplunkhf (production Splunk heavy forwarder), prddnighting01 (production Nightingale node 01), sts/teststs (ADFS federation). Reverse proxies at 7 explicit IPs in the 193.58.149.0/24 range. No cloud provider patterns (no AWS/GCP/Azure subdomains visible). wp5-truststroke.uzleuven.be geo-restricts /api/ to BE/NL IPs — EU-only access enforcement. INTIGRITI BOUNTY TABLE: Coarse-grained — only min/max range known from dump; refine from program Rewards tab if drafting against medium/low severity. SUBMISSION FORM: Best-guess URL; confirm by reading program page once before submitting. SAFE-DEFAULT FLAGS: bucket_listing_allowed=true (no bucket-related policy found; safe default applied); bucket_download_allowed=false (no policy found; safe default applied); requires_ownership_proof=true (no explicit waiver found; safe default applied). Per-asset severity_cap mapped from Tier 1/2/3 to critical/high/medium; No Bounty assets capped at info (VDP-only within bounty program — will not pay bounty, confirm before drafting).
